description: This file defines an Angular service class 'OtaUpdateTableConfigResolve' that configures and manages the table display and actions for OTA packages in the Thingsboard UI, including fetching data, handling actions, and defining table columns.

classes.name: OtaUpdateTableConfigResolve
classes.description: Angular service class that provides configuration for OTA update packages table, including data fetching, actions, and column definitions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for OTA packages, setting the table title.

methods.name: openOtaPackage
methods.description: Opens the OTA package details page in the router.

methods.name: exportPackage
methods.description: Handles the download or URL opening for OTA packages.

methods.name: checksumText
methods.description: Generates a truncated checksum text for display.

methods.name: onPackageAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered on OTA package entries, such as open or uploadPackage.
